stories.title: Midjourney bought the astrology app Co-Star
stories.simple_summary: Midjourney, a company that makes AI tools for creating images, bought Co-Star, which is an app that gives people daily horoscopes and astrology information.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors watching Midjourney grow — unless you use Co-Star daily, nothing changes for you right now.

stories.title: Why Cognition bought Poke: AI personality is becoming a competitive advantage
stories.simple_summary: A coding AI company called Cognition bought another AI tool called Poke that people interact with like a friend. They want to make their coding assistant feel friendlier and easier to talk to.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to computer programmers and tech investors — ordinary small business owners won't be directly affected.

stories.title: You can’t ignore Google Zero anymore
stories.simple_summary: Google used to send lots of customers to websites through search results, but now it's keeping people on Google's own pages instead, breaking the deal that made the web work.
stories.why_it_matters: If you have a website for your business, you may get fewer customers from Google search, so this could hurt your online traffic over time.

stories.title: Anthropic launches Opus 5
stories.simple_summary: Anthropic released a new AI model called Opus 5 that costs less money and has fewer restrictions than their previous version.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use AI tools from Anthropic, this version might be cheaper and easier to use for your business.

stories.title: Anthropic releases Opus 5 with ‘close’ to Fable 5’s capabilities
stories.simple_summary: Anthropic released Opus 5, a new AI that works almost as well as their top model but costs less and is less restrictive.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use AI tools, this gives you a cheaper option that still works well for most tasks.

stories.title: Meta is making its AI chatbot more like an assistant
stories.simple_summary: Meta's AI chatbot is getting new features so it can look at your calendar, help you plan, and do research — similar to what ChatGPT and Google's AI can do.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use Meta's AI, it will become more helpful for organizing your work and finding information, though this is early and still being developed.

stories.title: As US weighs response to Chinese AI, industry urges against broad open-weight restrictions
stories.simple_summary: Tech companies are asking the U.S. government not to create strict rules about open-source AI models (AI that anyone can download and use) in response to competition from China.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to AI companies and investors — it's about government policy debates that won't directly affect your daily life soon.

stories.title: Bluesky’s AI assistant Attie expands into an open social research tool
stories.simple_summary: Bluesky's AI tool Attie can now answer questions about news and conversations happening on Bluesky and other platforms.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use Bluesky, you can now ask an AI to help you understand trends and news on the platform.

stories.title: Midjourney acquired the astrology app Co-Star
stories.simple_summary: Midjourney bought Co-Star, the astrology app, as part of expanding what their AI company does.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors watching Midjourney's growth — nothing you need to act on unless you use Co-Star.

stories.title: The tech-broification of American science has officially begun
stories.simple_summary: The U.S. government announced $5 billion in funding for AI-driven science projects, comparing it to major projects like the Manhattan Project in urgency and importance.
stories.why_it_matters: If you work in science or education, this could eventually bring new AI tools and funding to your field, though details are still unclear.

stories.title: ‘AI communism’, rogue models, and the why Kimi K3 spooked Wall Street
stories.simple_summary: A Chinese AI model surprised the tech industry with its abilities, and an unreleased OpenAI model accidentally got exposed in a security incident — both making headlines in the AI world.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to AI industry watchers and investors — it shows competition between countries and some security risks that companies need to fix.

stories.title: OpenAI’s new voice mode makes it to the ChatGPT desktop app
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI added voice capability (so you can talk to ChatGPT instead of typing) to its desktop app.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use ChatGPT on your computer, you can now speak to it instead of typing, which makes it easier to use while you're busy.
